rules.name: Python eval()
rules.recommendation: eval() executes arbitrary Python code. Use ast.literal_eval() for safe parsing.

rules.name: Python exec()
rules.recommendation: exec() executes arbitrary Python code. This is almost always a security risk.

rules.name: Pickle Deserialization
rules.recommendation: pickle.load() can execute arbitrary code from untrusted data. Use JSON or safe alternatives.

rules.name: Shell Injection Risk
rules.recommendation: subprocess with shell=True is vulnerable to command injection. Use shell=False with a list of args.

rules.name: OS Command Execution
rules.recommendation: os.system()/os.popen() are vulnerable to command injection. Use subprocess with shell=False.

rules.name: Dynamic Import
rules.recommendation: __import__() with user input can load arbitrary modules. Validate module names against an allowlist.

rules.name: Bare Except Clauses
rules.recommendation: Multiple bare except: clauses found. These catch all exceptions including SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt.

rules.name: Debug Mode Enabled
rules.recommendation: DEBUG = True found. Ensure this is disabled in production.

rules.name: Assert in Production
rules.recommendation: Multiple assert statements found. Assertions are stripped with python -O. Use proper validation.

rules.name: HTTP Request Without Timeout
rules.recommendation: requests calls without a timeout will hang forever on a dead socket. Add timeout= argument.
